note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; source types are shown as stated by the witness, never assessed or ranked.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional pair: the same statement, once as seen by the witness and once as told to the witness by a neighbour.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different statement and people; in B the information comes from a shop owner and reaches the witness by a sequence link (drawn as a solid arrow, still not causal).

props.statement: The shop shutter was already half open

scenarioA.label: Seen by the witness
scenarioA.caption: The witness says they saw the shutter

scenarioB.label: Heard from the shop owner
scenarioB.caption: The witness says the shop owner told them

params.changedFact: Who saw the shutter, as stated

comparisonLabels.neutral: The two cards are kept side by side, as stated; nothing is weighed

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names and roles, a longer statement, longer source labels and origin, long scenario labels, captions, changed fact, shared facts and notes (each at least as long as the baseline).

props.statement: The same delivery van drove away from the yard before midnight

scenarioA.label: Direct observation from the window
scenarioA.caption: The witness says they watched the van leave from the window

scenarioB.label: Information received next morning
scenarioB.caption: The witness says the neighbour upstairs told them the next day

params.changedFact: How the witness says they came to know the van had left
sharedFacts: Same person giving the account and same clerk

comparisonLabels.guide: Only the stated source of the information differs
comparisonLabels.neutral: Both cards record the source exactly as stated; neither scene is ranked or weighed

presets.name: baseline-es
presets.description: Baseline in Spanish (built-in labels and fictional content).
